variants.name: Vortex
variants.detail: VARIANT A — VORTEX: closest to original heart. A floating almost-black violet orb with a single broad luminous violet circular rim and only TWO broad spiral bands suggesting a dark portal inside. A short tapered violet energy connection to a simple circular socket in the low square pedestal. The round void must read first, not microtexture. Keep all four corner stones and a quiet, compact square altar.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE finished native-transparent 2D sprite of the dungeon heart for a mobile game.
Image 1 is the EXISTING HEART reference: retain its square low blue-slate pedestal, four short corner stones and floating dark orb, but simplify the painting for small screen readability.
Image 2 is the original GAME MOCKUP style reference: hand-painted cartoon dungeon, chunky rounded blue-grey stone, dark outlines, broad readable light/shadow shapes, gloomy palette and concentrated violet magic. Image 3 is the CURRENT GAME background for palette/scale compatibility.
This is a 2D game prop, NOT a geometrically projected architecture module. The floor grid is square and flat. The square pedestal should face the viewer squarely with horizontal front/back edges and vertical side footprint edges, not a rotated isometric diamond or tapering trapezoid. Shallow visible front thickness is a painted illusion. Keep the subject centered, complete, with ample transparent margin, no cropped glow.
The full stone base will be displayed about 160 pixels wide; the floating core about 85 pixels across. Thus favor big readable forms and 2-3 light values. Low pedestal, four simple rounded corner blocks, dark blue-grey stone close to current game. Restrained violet reflected light, no white blown-out masonry. No tiny inscriptions, no fine veins, no small particles, no UI, no lettering, no ground tile or floor patch, no external scenery. A subtle native-alpha contact shadow immediately beneath the base is welcome. The shape must sit on a flat 2D floor. No metal rings, no tall pillars, no anatomical heart. Genuine transparency outside the entire prop.

A short tapered violet energy connection to a simple circular socket in the low square pedestal. The round void must read first, not microtexture. Keep all four corner stones and a quiet, compact square altar.

variants.name: Noyau fissuré
variants.detail: VARIANT B — FRACTURED CORE: a floating dark rounded stone-like magical orb, visibly spherical, with TWO or THREE substantial irregular violet fissures exposing a bright inner core. These must be broad painted cracks with depth, not thin branching line doodles or a repeating Y symbol. A restrained glow at its lower edge connects it to the pedestal socket. Same low square slate base and four short corner stones, with calm surfaces. Emphasize the heavy dark sphere and its glowing split silhouette rather than a circular neon ring.

variants.name: Éclipse
variants.detail: VARIANT C — ECLIPSE: a floating nearly black smooth orb with a single bold violet luminous crescent wrapping the upper-left portion and a subdued violet lower-right rim. The center stays almost empty and dark. A small tapered violet energy tongue descends into the pedestal socket. Same compact square blue-slate base with four short corner stones. Strong, quiet silhouette, few broad painted facets; no swirling internal microdetails and no fine particle halo. The crescent gives this version its identity at tiny scale.
